editorial:
You're dropped into a rainy, corrupt city where a drug heist goes sideways and a jaded cop named Walker has to fight through gangs and crooked cops to save a politician's son. Tom Hardy leads the charge with gritty energy, and the movie never really lets you catch your breath. It feels like a dark comic book come to life, with every scene pushing you deeper into the underworld and raising the stakes.

The action is brutal and well-staged, with long fight scenes that feel like a video game level you can't pause. The story is thin and some characters feel flat, but if you want nonstop thrills, this delivers in a big way. Just don't expect deep drama, because this one is all about the punch.
endingExplained: In the final act, Walker tracks Charlie to a warehouse where corrupt cops and gangsters close in. A massive shootout erupts, and Walker kills Vincent and his dirty squad while the triad matriarch dies in the crossfire. Charlie survives and is reunited with his father. Wounded but alive, Walker lets his partner Ellie take Charlie to safety, completing his redemption and walking away from the chaos he helped create.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-octane action and dark crime stories.
